title: Anticanonical nonvanishing from smooth semipositivity
exact_target: For every smooth connected projective complex X, if $-K_X$ admits a smooth Hermitian metric with semipositive Chern curvature, must $H^{0}(X,-mK_X)\neq 0$ for some positive integer m?
